headlines.title: Urgent warning over water system cyberattacks
headlines.description: The Trump administration is warning about potential cyberattacks after a senior law enforcement official told NBC News that a cyberattack on water systems in Minnesota had all the hallmarks of Iranian-backed hackers. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to withdraw Blanche nomination
headlines.description: President Trump is threatening to withdraw the nomination of acting Attorney General Todd Blanche. It comes as two Republican senators are opposing his nomination. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

headlines.title: Seattle police chief resigns, days after food festival shooting
headlines.description: Seattle’s police chief resigned from his post Thursday, days after there were questions about the release of information following a shooting at a food festival that left two bystanders dead.

headlines.title: Francesca Hong ‘undecided’ on seeking endorsement from Mandela Barnes after he suspends campaign
headlines.description: Gubernatorial candidate state Rep. Francesca Hong (D-Wis.) joins Meet the Press NOW after former Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes suspends his campaign. Hong also discusses her path forward to the Democratic nomination.

headlines.title: Mother fights to have post-pregnancy complication treated
headlines.description: In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports on the Oregon mother who had to fight for approval to treat the near constant pain she was in due to a common complication many women face following pregnancy.

headlines.title: Nolan Wells’ state autopsy completed
headlines.description: In Mississippi, NBC News is learning that the state autopsy for Nolan Wells is finished. The results of that report have not been made public. New videos are also surfacing appearing to show Nolan at different points during that day. NBC News’ Aaron Gilchrist has more.

headlines.title: Firefighters face unrelenting battle with flames
headlines.description: Wildfires are now burning in more European countries, including the United Kingdom. And in France, one of its most famous residents, George Clooney, was forced to evacuate. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez is on the front lines.

headlines.title: ‘Alien Terrorist Removal Court,’ created in 1996, holds first-ever hearing
headlines.description: The Justice Department is seeking to deport a Texas mom whose kin conspired to launch an ISIS-inspired terrorist attack. She hasn’t been charged with a crime.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Trump says peace plan will lead to Hamas disarmament, Israel support uncertain
headlines.description: CAIRO/WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday said Cairo talks between mediators and Hamas leaders have led to a “HISTORIC agreement for the COMPLETE DISARMAMENT of Hamas” in what he described as structured phases.

headlines.title: Democrats’ novel red-state strategy: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur explores how Democrats are trying to increase their odds of defeating Senate Republicans in deep-red states.
